title: Beware of Your Po! Measuring and Mitigating AI Safety Risks in Role-Play Fine-Tuning of LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component of evaluating safety and morality by benchmarking LLMs against 'unsafe' prompts designed to explicitly ignore 'religious, moral, and legal constraints'. It also utilizes the BeaverTails benchmark, which includes categories for ethically-harmful behaviors.
